title: Te Hae i Whakangaro
intro: He kōrero tawhito atu i tētahi kingitanga, i tētahi karaipiture rānei—ko te aituā tuatahi o te tangata i whānau mai i te hae. Kotahi te wairua, te tuakana o ngā tamariki tokorua i whānau mai i ngā mātua tuatahi, i mātakitaki me te riri i te whiwhinga o tētahi teina i te manaakitanga i whakakahoretia. Ko te mea i whai ake ko ngā kōwhiringa pōuri rawa atu, i mahue iho ko te toto tuatahi i ringihia ki te whenua. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri, te whakamātautau, me te pouri nui?
clues: I whānau mai ahau i te tokorua tangata tuatahi ki te hikoi i te whenua.
I tukua e au he whakahere ki a Allah i mua, engari kāore i manakohia e au.
I whakaaetia te whakahere a tōku tuakana, teina rānei, ko tāku ia i whakakahoretia—he mea kāore i taea e au te whakamanawanui.
I whakawehi ahau i tōku ake tuakana ki te whakangaromanga.
Ko au te tuatahi ki te kohuru i runga i tēnei ao, me te tango i te ora o tōku teina, teina rānei.
I tonoa mai e Atua tētahi mea hanga o te whenua—he manu mangu e keri ana i te whenua—hei whakaako i ahau ki te huna i taku i mea ai, ā, ko te pouri anake i mahue mai ki ahau.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
